note: Effective TN = skill/attribute TN - tier penalty. Roll d20 <= Effective TN to succeed. Natural 1 / 20 always add a narrative consequence (GM decides).

tiers.name: Routine
tiers.example: Clear line of sight, stable footing, standard net access, low stress.

tiers.name: Challenging
tiers.example: Partial cover, light rain or fog, basic civilian encryption, minor time pressure.

tiers.name: Hard
tiers.example: Heavy rain, low light, commercial firewalls, firing while moving into cover.

tiers.name: Severe
tiers.example: Full cover, zero visibility or heavy smoke, military-grade encryption, active suppression.

tiers.name: Extreme
tiers.example: Dangling from a moving aircraft, active thermal lockout, firing blind into cover.

tiers.name: Nightmare
tiers.example: Complex actions during a System Hard Reboot, cracking a megacorp core under fire.
